name: NEXGRAM
recent: Nexgram 近期出现多项董事与主要股东变动：Cheang Soon Siang 于10月15日改任集团执行董事总经理，Chia Peng Lun 于10月27日辞去独立非执行董事职务。公司于8月19日撤回向 Bursa 提交的企业重组申请，并在10月15日出现大股东持股变动。最新季度（截至2026年7月31日）营收环比和同比均增长，但净利同比大幅下滑。
notable: Cheang Soon Siang 于2026年10月15日改任集团执行董事总经理。
Chia Peng Lun 于2026年10月27日辞去独立非执行董事及多个委员会成员职务。
公司于2026年8月19日撤回向 Bursa 提交的企业重组申请。
risks: Cheang Soon Siang 于2026年10月14日以视同权益方式交易55,975,003股普通股（占5.725%）。
Sapphire Pavilion Limited 于2026年10月15日成为主要股东（持股变动通知）。
Tuan Haji Mazru Bin Mat Yusof 于2026年10月15日不再是大股东（持股终止通知）。
earnings: 截至2026年7月31日的季度，营收为 MYR 22,890,527，环比增长42.4%，同比增长82.8%；净利为 MYR 3,876,406，净利率16.9%，但净利同比下滑82.7%（上一年同期净利率为-22.0%）。

recent_en: Nexgram saw several board and major shareholder changes recently: Cheang Soon Siang was redesignated as Executive Group Managing Director on 15 October, while Chia Peng Lun resigned as Independent Non-Executive Director effective 27 October. The company withdrew its corporate restructuring application to Bursa on 19 August and had changes in substantial shareholder interests on 15 October. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue rose both QoQ and YoY, but net profit fell sharply YoY.
notable_en: Cheang Soon Siang was redesignated as Executive Group Managing Director on 15 October 2026.
Chia Peng Lun resigned as Independent Non-Executive Director and member of several committees effective 27 October 2026.
The company withdrew its corporate restructuring application to Bursa on 19 August 2026.
risks_en: Cheang Soon Siang dealt in 55,975,003 ordinary shares (5.725%) via deemed interest on 14 October 2026.
Sapphire Pavilion Limited became a substantial shareholder on 15 October 2026 (notice of interest).
Tuan Haji Mazru Bin Mat Yusof ceased to be a substantial shareholder on 15 October 2026 (notice of ceasing).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 22,890,527, up 42.4% QoQ and 82.8% YoY; net income was MYR 3,876,406 with a net margin of 16.9%, but net income fell 82.7% YoY (prior-year net margin was -22.0%).
